title: Ridgepost Capital Announces Appointment of Director of Operations and Expansion of Global Client Solutions Team
summary: Ridgepost Capital announced the addition of Wendy Reese as Director of Operations, effective June 18, 2026.
body_markdown:
DALLAS, June 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Ridgepost Capital, Inc. (“Ridgepost”) (NYSE: RPC) today announced the addition of Wendy Reese as Director of Operations, effective June 18, 2026, alongside recent hires within our Global Client Solutions business.


[Read the full press release.](https://ir.ridgepostcapital.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ridgepost-capital-announces-appointment-director-operations-and)
